items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XVI, List of Answers on Terminology 57:1
items.html: The appearance of the concluding Malchut at the point of the Chazeh [chest] of Yetzirah, which made there a border and conclusion to holiness, is that He said to His world "Enough" [Dai], "do not spread further." See above, answer 27. (Item 62).
